items.title: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice
items.summary: By dismissing the suit with prejudice, Trump can't file another amended version in district court. Trump's legal team said the president plans to appeal.

items.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
items.summary: The funding round is still in progress and has not closed, so the figures are subject to change, a person directly familiar with the deal told CNBC.

items.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
items.summary: The group did not release a joint communique but will rather rely on a chairman's statement, which U.S Secretary of State Rubio said he would release Saturday.

items.title: OpenAI slashes funding target by $10 billion amid tech rout, FT reports
items.summary: Sam Altman's OpenAI is seeking about $20 billion with a desired valuation of $1.25 trillion, down from $1.4 billion, FT reported, citing people familiar.

items.title: Qatari mediators held talks in Tehran aimed at restarting direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, source says
items.summary: Axios reported that Qatari mediators held more than 12 hours of talks in Tehran on Friday to reach a deal to avoid a resumption of American-led attacks on Iran.

items.title: Automatic 401(k) rollovers reduce cash-outs, research finds — but few accounts reach new employer plans
items.summary: Workers with small 401(k) balances are cashing out less often under an automatic portability program, but most accounts remain in temporary IRAs.
